chapter_seo_title: Fan Ren Zhi Shang Chapter 358: Han Li Commissions Grade Four Demon Beast Tools & Visits the Star Dust Pavilion
chapter_meta_description: Han Li commissions custom tools from Grade Four demon beast materials and navigates the war-driven panic market, heading to the Heavenly Star Sect's Star Dust Pavilion for real treasures.
og_description: Han Li turns battlefield spoils into custom weapons and navigates a war-torn market in this masterclass of mortal-stream preparation.
twitter_description: Han Li plays the market, commissioning rare weapons and scouting the Star Dust Pavilion’s social battlefield.

lore_anchors.definition: A classification of demon beasts in the Mortal Stream, representing significantly more powerful entities than low-grade beasts; materials from them are exceedingly rare and valuable.
The second major realm in cultivation, marking a cultivator as a true member of the higher tiers of the sect, with access to greater resources, duties, and respect.
The third major realm, representing a leap in power and lifespan; Core Formation cultivators are figures of immense authority, often forming the highest leadership of major sects.
The specialized art of a cultivation craftsman who forges and imbues materials into magical tools and artifacts; top-tier refiners are highly sought-after assets.
